items.headline: v1 completions endpoint gets a shutdown date
items.source_excerpt: The v1 completions endpoint stops accepting requests on 2027-03-01. The v2 endpoint becomes the default for new API keys on 2026-12-01, and existing keys migrate to v2 in 2027-01. Streaming responses are unchanged between the two versions.

items.headline: Beacon adds hybrid search
items.source_excerpt: The Beacon vector store now supports hybrid search, combining keyword and embedding scores in one query. Hybrid search is available on all paid plans and adds no per-query charge. Existing indexes are upgraded in place without a rebuild.
